name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Sen. Lindsey Graham's cause of death was aortic dissection, medical examiner says
changes.summary: President Trump paid tribute to the late senator, who was reportedly scheduled to do an interview on Sunday.

changes.title: Former member of federal Election Assistance Commission speaks out after dismissal
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Benjamin Hovland, one of three members of the Election Assistance Commission fired last week by President Trump.

changes.title: Mercurial and Magnetic, Lindsey Graham Was a Force in the Senate
changes.summary: The sharp-witted South Carolinian repaired relations with President Trump to advance his foreign policy goals, was willing to cut deals with Democrats and tried to insert himself into every legislative fight.

changes.title: With Lindsey Graham Gone, Ukraine Loses an Ally in Trump’s Ear
changes.summary: The South Carolina Republican was Ukraine’s most influential champion inside President Trump’s mostly “America First” political orbit.

changes.summary: The United States and Iran traded even more attacks, some of the most intense in months, as the already fragile ceasefire continues to unravel. changes.title: Oil jumps 6% after Trump reimposes Iran blockade on Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: The price of oil jumped after President Trump declared on social media that the U.S. would be “reimbursed” for helping ships transit the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Trump recommends South Carolina’s governor appoint Lindsey Graham’s sister to finish his Senate term
changes.summary: President Donald Trump said Monday that he has recommended to South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster that he choose Lindsey Graham’s sister, Darline Graham Nordone, to serve the remainder of the late Republican senator’s term, which ends in early January.

changes.title: Trump says the U.S. will reinstate its blockade on Iran and charge a toll on ships
changes.summary: The move comes after the U.S. and Iran exchanged fire for the third weekend in a row, raising the specter of a return to all-out war after a shaky ceasefire took effect in June. (Image credit: AFPTV).

changes.title: Trump urges S.C. governor to appoint Sen. Graham's sister as temporary replacement
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham died over the weekend at age 71, and Gov. Henry McMaster is expected to announce his pick later Monday.
